_about: Domain rules for .claude/hooks/domain_rules.py (idea from Basemode's domains.toml, 2026-10-27). A domain fires when a prompt holds one of its keywords (UserPromptSubmit) or when Claude is about to write a file matching one of its globs (PreToolUse on Edit/Write). Each domain's rule is injected at most once per session. Keep each rule to one or two lines: do Y, because Z.

antigravity-kit.rule: src/ui-ux-pro-max/ is the source of truth: edit there, then copy data/, scripts/ and templates/ into cli/assets/ before publishing, because the CLI ships cli/assets/ (.claude/playbooks/antigravity-kit.md, Sync Rules).

nqos-hooks.rule: Run the matching .claude/hooks/test_*.py (or .claude/brain/tests/) before committing a hook or brain script, and tell Omarie to restart the session after settings.json or a hook changes, because hooks load at session start.

nqos-agents.rule: Agent classes decide model and effort; change MESH.md and the agent file together, because the policy and the agent frontmatter must agree (.claude/agentmesh/MESH.md).

formula-dynamics.rule: Formula Dynamics keeps FD red and Bebas Neue; never mix another brand into the piece, and ask which style first (CLAUDE.md, The standard for every job).

supercar-experience.rule: Supercar Experience is gold on black; house style and feedback log live in supercar-experience/09-campaign-ads/HOUSE-STYLE.md on its branch. Ask which style first.

anti-stock.rule: Anti Stock keeps its own look; Fast Cut and Reel Cut are its approved formats. Ask which style first.
